answer: PUF-bound kernel attestation with mirror audits: each agent runs in a TEE; its kernel measures the agent code and derives a per-boot key from a physical unclonable function (PUF). Registration posts the PUF challenge-response and measurement to a public mirror log; a raven auditor re-challenges logged agents and rejects duplicate PUF fingerprints or impossible measurement transitions. Sybils require distinct PUF-equipped devices per identity; cloning one or forging attestations means breaking the PUF/TEE and kernel measurement chain.
